description: This file declares the dmProviderDatabase class, which manages provider information by loading data from a directory, creating queries, and retrieving provider info by various identifiers. It defines the interface, including methods for loading data and accessing provider info, with references to related classes like dmProviderInfo, dmQuery, dmProviderOperation, and dmPropertyInfo.
